The included checker reproduces 1021 rational feasibility/identity assertions plus logarithm spot checks.

originality.rationale: The well-mixed geometric-mean criterion and Bernoulli moment constraints are acknowledged prior art. The specific sharp monotone exponent envelope conditional on every one- and two-site environmental moment, coupled to an exact pairwise-independent reversal of almost-sure growth, was not found in these searches. Priority is provisional because one very close ecological source was not fully available and general moment optimization might subsume the construction.

Higher-order dependence may be familiar to experts; novelty of the ecological persistence-sign witness needs independent human review.

value.rationale: The theorem answers the motivated ecological inference question of whether measured marginal productivity and every pairwise synchrony suffice to diagnose growth/decline. It proves the full sharp continuous parameter envelope and provides the first nontrivial patch-count boundary (three) with an exact pairwise-independent sign reversal; the result is not only a small numerical improvement.
